〈關雎〉寫一個人看見心上人，想了一整夜，輾轉反側。詩裡沒寫對方怎麼想，只寫了想念: "Guanju" describes someone who sees the one they love and lies awake all night, tossing and turning. The poem doesn't say what the other person thinks — only the longing itself. Yue Lao borrows it to tell you: your back-and-forth right now is normal, and proof that you care.
《中庸》說天下共通的五種人倫：君臣、父子、夫婦、兄弟、朋友之交。夫婦是其中之一，: The Doctrine of the Mean names five universal human bonds: ruler and subject, father and son, husband and wife, brothers, and friends. Marriage is one of them and must be tended with care.
《中庸》讚美舜的大孝：因為德行深厚，得到尊位、名聲與長壽，連祖先宗廟都受到祭祀、: The Doctrine of the Mean praises the great filial piety of Shun: because of his deep virtue he gained high rank, renown and long life; even his ancestral temple received offerings and his line continued.
《千字文》句子，講天下歸心、遠近一體。: A line from the Thousand Character Classic about all under heaven uniting, near and far as one.
《古詩十九首·迢迢牽牛星》寫牛郎織女隔河相望，近在咫尺卻無法相聚。: "Far Away, the Cowherd Star" from the Nineteen Old Poems shows the Cowherd and Weaver Girl gazing across the river, so close yet unable to meet.
《史記·平津侯主父列傳》漢武帝見到主父偃等人，相談甚歡，說「何相見之晚也」。: In the Records of the Grand Historian, Emperor Wu of Han meets Zhufu Yan and others, enjoys their talk, and says, "Why did we meet so late?"
《史記·淮陰侯列傳》蒯通勸韓信：你手握重兵，左右兩邊都忌憚你，處境其實很危險。: In the Records of the Grand Historian, Kuai Tong warns Han Xin: with great armies in hand, both sides fear you — your position is actually very dangerous.
《周易·乾卦·文言》說同類相感：同聲相應、同氣相求，雲從龍、風從虎。: The Book of Changes says like attracts like: same voices answer each other, kindred spirits seek each other; clouds follow the dragon, wind follows the tiger.
《周易》常見的爻辭「利有攸往」，意思是適合行動、往前走。: A common line in the Book of Changes, "it is favorable to have somewhere to go," meaning it's a good time to act and move forward.
《增廣賢文》的俗語，講世事常常不如預期，刻意追求的不一定得到，無心之處反而有收穫: A saying from Words that Widen Wisdom: things often don't go as planned; what you chase may not come, while what you ignore may bear fruit.
《增廣賢文》裡的俗語，講凡事要未雨綢繆、早做準備。: A saying from Words that Widen Wisdom about planning ahead and preparing early.
《大學》說本末先後要分清：連自己身邊親近的人都怠慢，卻去厚待疏遠的人，是不可能的: The Great Learning says to keep root and branch in order: neglecting those close to you while lavishing care on strangers can never work.
《大學》說治理國家要先重德行，有德才有人心，有人心才有土地與財富；本末不能顛倒。: The Great Learning says governing a state begins with virtue: virtue wins people's hearts, and hearts bring land and wealth; root and branch must not be reversed.
《大學》說能做到這樣的人很少，因為人往往被好惡蒙蔽。這是修身齊家的功夫。: The Great Learning says few people manage this, because likes and dislikes cloud judgment. It's the work of cultivating yourself and your family.
《孔子家語·六本》說：不知其子視其父，不知其人視其友。: The School Sayings of Confucius: if you don't know a son, look at his father; if you don't know a person, look at their friends.
《孟子·公孫丑上》孟子說到自己想學的人，對某些人「姑舍是」，先放下不談。: In Mencius, speaking of people he might learn from, Mencius says of some, "let us set this aside."
《孟子·告子上》「一暴十寒」：曬一天、凍十天，再好的植物也長不起來。說的是不持續: Mencius's "one day of sun, ten days of frost": warmed one day and frozen ten, even the best plant can't grow. Without consistency, nothing gets done.
《孟子·告子下》「天將降大任於是人也，必先苦其心志」，困難是成長的磨練。: Mencius: "When heaven is about to give someone a great task, it first tests their resolve" — difficulty is training for growth.
《孟子·梁惠王上》孟子說齊宣王想用武力稱霸，方法錯了，就像緣木求魚，不可能得到。: Mencius tells King Xuan of Qi that seeking dominance by force is the wrong method — like climbing a tree to catch fish, it can't succeed.
《孟子·盡心上》君子三樂之一：仰不愧於天、俯不怍於人。: One of the gentleman's three joys in Mencius: to have nothing to be ashamed of before heaven or people.
《孟子·盡心上》講仁義禮智這類操之在我的東西：肯求就得到，不求就失去。: Mencius speaks of things within our own power, like kindness and wisdom: seek them and you gain them; don't, and you lose them.
《孟子·盡心下》曾皙愛吃羊棗，他死後兒子曾子不忍再吃。說的是每個人有自己獨特的喜: In Mencius, Zeng Xi loved goat dates, and after he died his son Zengzi couldn't bear to eat them. Everyone has their own particular tastes.
《孟子·萬章上》子產放生一條魚，小吏騙他說魚游走了，子產高興地說「得其所哉」。: In Mencius, Zichan has a fish released; a clerk lies that it swam away, and Zichan says happily, "It has found its place!"
《孟子·離婁上》以舜為例，講孝順是做人的根本。: Mencius uses Shun as an example to say filial piety is the root of being a person.
《孟子·離婁下》「齊人乞墦」：齊人每天在外乞食祭品，回家卻吹噓與權貴吃喝。妻妾跟: In Mencius, a man of Qi begs leftover offerings at graves every day, then boasts at home of dining with the powerful. His wife and concubine follow him, learn the truth, and weep together.
《左傳·成公九年》引用的詩句，告誡人有了好的也不要捨棄舊的，要念舊。: Lines quoted in the Zuo Zhuan, warning that even when you have something good, you shouldn't cast off the old — value old bonds.
《左傳·昭公四年》子產推行改革遭人非議，他說只要對國家有利，不怕人言。: In the Zuo Zhuan, Zichan faces criticism for his reforms and says that as long as it benefits the state, he doesn't fear gossip.
《左傳·桓公二年》師服論命名：「嘉耦曰妃，怨耦曰仇」，好的配偶稱為妃（配）。: In the Zuo Zhuan, Shi Fu discusses naming: "a happy couple is called a match, an unhappy one a foe."
《左傳·桓公六年》齊侯想把女兒嫁給鄭國太子忽，太子忽推辭說「人各有耦，齊大，非吾: In the Zuo Zhuan, the Marquis of Qi offers his daughter to Prince Hu of Zheng, who declines: "Everyone has their own match; Qi is too great to be mine" — not reaching above his station.
《左傳·桓公十一年》楚國莫敖想占卜，鬥廉說：心裡已經有定見，何必再卜。: In the Zuo Zhuan, when the Mo'ao of Chu wants to divine, Dou Lian says: your mind is already made up, so why divine?
《左傳·莊公二十二年》陳國懿氏要把女兒嫁給敬仲，占卜得到「鳳凰于飛，和鳴鏘鏘」，: In the Zuo Zhuan, the Yi family of Chen divines about marrying their daughter to Jing Zhong and receives "the phoenixes fly together, calling in harmony" — a most auspicious marriage omen.
《左傳·隱公十一年》鄭莊公談到許國，提到與許國原有婚姻之親，問對方是否願意屈從相: In the Zuo Zhuan, Duke Zhuang of Zheng, speaking of the state of Xu, mentions their old marriage ties and asks whether Xu will yield and make peace.
《楚辭·九歌·少司命》寫神與人短暫相會又分離的悲喜。: "The Lesser Master of Fate" in the Songs of Chu describes the joy and sorrow of a god and a mortal meeting briefly and parting.
《漢書·外戚傳》說：帝王興盛，不只靠自己的德行，也得到賢內助、外戚的幫助。強調另: The Book of Han says a ruler's rise depends not only on his own virtue but also on a capable spouse and her family — stressing the strength of a partner and family.
《漢書·景帝紀》景帝說華麗的雕刻、錦繡是傷害農事與女紅的奢侈之物，主張務實。: In the Book of Han, Emperor Jing calls ornate carvings and brocades luxuries that harm farming and weaving, and urges practicality.
《禮記·哀公問》孔子說妻子是祭祀祖先、主持家務的人，必須敬重她。: In the Book of Rites, Confucius says the wife leads the ancestral rites and runs the household and must be respected.
《禮記·曲禮上》講軍隊行進時的旗幟陣列，四方神獸守護，象徵周全有序。: The Book of Rites describes the banners of an army on the march, guarded by the four sacred beasts — a symbol of order and completeness.
《禮記·經解》講禮的作用：懂得禮，就像有了尺規，是非曲直一看就明白，別人騙不了你: The Book of Rites explains the role of ritual: knowing propriety is like having a ruler and compass — right and wrong are obvious at a glance, and no one can deceive you.
《莊子·達生》說：真正合適的東西，會讓人感覺不到它的存在。: Zhuangzi says what truly fits is something you don't even notice.
《西廂記》結尾的祝願，張生與崔鶯鶯歷經波折終成眷屬，也是月老廟最常見的對聯。: The closing wish of Romance of the Western Chamber, where Scholar Zhang and Cui Yingying finally marry after many trials — also the most common couplet at Yue Lao temples.
《詩經·中谷有蓷》寫一個女子遭遇荒年又被丈夫拋棄，嘆息自己嫁錯了人。: "Motherwort in the Valley" in the Book of Songs tells of a woman abandoned by her husband in a year of famine, lamenting that she married the wrong man.
《詩經·十畝之間》寫採桑人收工時悠然自得、相約一同回家，透出安穩自在的田園生活。: "Among Ten Acres" from the Book of Songs shows mulberry pickers finishing work at leisure and heading home together — a calm, easy country life.
《詩經·周南·螽斯》以螽斯多子，祝福人家子孫興旺。: "Locusts" in the Book of Songs uses the many offspring of locusts to bless a family with flourishing descendants.
《詩經·大雅·靈臺》寫周文王建靈臺，百姓自動來幫忙，很快就完成。原意是吉，籤中取: "The Spirit Tower" in the Book of Songs describes King Wen of Zhou building a tower, the people coming to help of their own accord so it was finished quickly. The original is auspicious; the stick takes it as a warning against rushing.
《詩經·我行其野》是棄婦（或遠嫁者）之怨，責怪對方不念舊情、另尋新人。: "I Walk in the Fields" in the Book of Songs is the complaint of a cast-off wife (or a bride married far away), blaming the other for forgetting old ties and seeking someone new.
《詩經·摽有梅》寫待嫁的女子看著梅子一天天落下，催促求婚的人別錯過時機。: "Falling Plums" in the Book of Songs shows a young woman watching the plums fall day by day, urging suitors not to miss their chance.
《詩經·斯干》是祝賀新居落成的詩，裡面用夢占預祝子孫興旺。: "Si Gan" in the Book of Songs celebrates a new home, using dream omens to wish for thriving descendants.
《詩經·木瓜》寫男女互贈信物，回贈的比收到的貴重，不是為了報答，而是希望永遠相好: "The Quince" in the Book of Songs describes lovers exchanging tokens, returning something more precious than they received — not as repayment, but in hope of being together forever.
《詩經·桑中》寫男子回想與心上人在桑林約會、一路相送的情景，是古代少有的大膽戀歌: "In the Mulberry Grove" from the Book of Songs recalls a man's tryst with his beloved in a mulberry grove and how she saw him off — a rare bold love song of ancient times, often read as a secret meeting.
《詩經·谷風》是一首棄婦詩：女子說自己所受的苦比苦菜還苦，而丈夫卻和新人如膠似漆: "Valley Wind" in the Book of Songs is the lament of an abandoned wife: she says her suffering is bitterer than bitter herbs while her husband dotes on his new bride. The verse takes the sweetness of "newlyweds."
《詩經》開篇〈關雎〉，寫一個男子思慕河邊採荇菜的姑娘，日思夜想、輾轉難眠，最後想: "Guanju," the opening poem of the Book of Songs, tells of a man longing for a girl gathering water plants by the river — thinking of her day and night, tossing and turning, dreaming of welcoming her as his bride with zithers and bells. People of old saw it as the beginning of a good marriage.
《論語·先進》魯國要改建長府，閔子騫說維持舊樣子就好，何必勞民傷財。孔子稱讚他說: In the Analects, when Lu planned to rebuild the treasury, Min Ziqian said keeping it as it was would do — why waste people and money? Confucius praised his good sense.
《論語·公冶長》孔子說公冶長雖曾入獄卻不是他的錯，可以把女兒嫁給他，後來真的嫁了: In the Analects, Confucius says that although Gongye Chang had been jailed, it wasn't his fault, and he could marry Confucius's daughter — and later did. What mattered was character, not his circumstances at the time.
《論語·公冶長》季文子凡事三思而後行，孔子說：再思就夠了，想太多反而誤事。: In the Analects, Ji Wenzi thinks three times before every action; Confucius says twice is enough — overthinking only gets in the way.
《論語·子罕》孔子說後生可畏，年輕人有無限可能。: In the Analects, Confucius says the young are to be respected for their limitless potential.
《論語·子路》子夏當官，問為政之道，孔子這樣告誡他。: In the Analects, when Zixia takes office and asks how to govern, Confucius warns him this way.
《論語·學而》孔子提醒：說話好聽、表情討好的人，往往心不誠。: In the Analects, Confucius warns that those who speak sweetly and put on pleasing faces are often insincere.
《論語·泰伯》曾子說君子是這樣的人：可以託孤、可以寄命，面臨大節也不動搖。: In the Analects, Zengzi says a gentleman is someone you can entrust an orphan and a nation to, who won't waver in moments that matter.
《論語·述而》孔子說：財富如果求得到，再卑微的事我也肯做；求不到就做我喜歡的事。: In the Analects, Confucius says if wealth could be sought, he'd do even the humblest job; if not, he'd follow what he loves.
《論語·雍也》中孔子評論人時說「可也」，意思是不錯，但還有可以更好的地方。: In the Analects, Confucius judges someone as "he'll do" — good, with room to be better.
《論語》子貢以宮牆比喻：老師的學問像高牆，不得其門而入就看不到裡面宗廟之美、百官: In the Analects, Zigong compares his teacher to a palace wall: without finding the gate, you can't see the beauty of the temple and the richness of the officials inside. True worth is only visible once you step through the door.
《論語》裡孔子說：父母的年紀不能不知道，一方面為他們長壽而高興，一方面又為他們衰: In the Analects, Confucius says you must know your parents' ages: glad that they're living long, yet worried that they're growing old.
「鳳去秦樓」用蕭史弄玉乘鳳仙去的典故，「雲斂巫山」用巫山神女。都比喻人去樓空、良: "The phoenix leaves the Qin Tower" recalls Xiao Shi and Nongyu flying off as immortals on a phoenix; "clouds withdraw from Mount Wu" recalls the goddess of Wushan. Both mean the person is gone and the good match has passed.
一些互動讓你感到困惑。這些信號也可能來自壓力、誤解或關係變化，不能直接推斷出軌。: Some interactions leave you confused. These signals may also come from stress, misunderstanding or changes in the relationship; they can't be read as proof of cheating.
一些情境會影響你的安全感: Some situations affect your sense of security
一份新的感情湧上來，心是滿的，願意給也願意收。: A new feeling wells up; your heart is full, ready to give and to receive.
一個人扛了太多，這段關係的重量不該只在你肩上。: You're carrying too much alone; the weight of this relationship shouldn't rest only on you.
一個人撐著會累，想有人陪是很自然的事。今天不必立刻把自己變得堅強；先照顧好睡眠、: Holding it all together alone is tiring, and wanting company is natural. You don't have to become strong right now; look after your sleep and meals first, and try talking to someone you trust.
一個帶著好奇和熱情的新訊息、新對象。: A new message or a new person full of curiosity and enthusiasm.
一個溫柔的示好、浪漫的訊息或邀約。: A tender gesture, a romantic message or an invitation.
一個階段真正結束，結束之後才有新的開始。: One chapter truly ends, and only after an ending can something new begin.
一定先要磨練他的心志。: Heaven will first test his resolve.
一心用在偷香竊玉的事上，卻一直沒得到什麼；從海棠花開，想到現在。: All your heart went into a secret affair, yet you've gained nothing; you've been thinking of it since the crabapples bloomed.
一方面歡喜，一方面擔憂。: On one hand, joy; on the other, worry.
一時失去信心，別因為累就否定一切。: A moment of lost faith — don't reject everything just because you're tired.
一段剛開始的關係、單純的好感；也可能真的和孩子有關。: A relationship just starting, a simple liking — or something actually involving a child.
一段實實在在的開始，有基礎、能長久。: A real, solid beginning with a foundation that can last.
一段感情或一個階段的結束；痛，但有時正是你在等的那個了斷。: The end of a relationship or a stage — painful, but sometimes the closure you've been waiting for.
一線緣起，從相互願意開始。: A bond begins when both are willing.
一股新的熱情點燃了，心動是真的，趁熱表達。: A new passion is lit; the attraction is real, so say it while it's warm.
一開始就不清楚：誤會、隱瞞，或彼此都沒說明白。: It was unclear from the start: misunderstandings, things hidden, or nothing ever said plainly.
一開始就有人沒說實話，或另有打算。: From the start, someone wasn't honest or had other plans.
一開始就有阻礙，這件事本來就不容易。: There were obstacles from the start; this was never going to be easy.
一頭熱的局，你再熱也暖不了他。抽身吧。: It's one-sided; however warm you are, you can't warm them up. Step away.
一點一點用心經營，感情是磨出來的。: Nurturing it with care, bit by bit — love is something you work at.
一點一點被耗掉：焦慮、猜疑、小事累積成大事。: Being worn down bit by bit: anxiety, suspicion, small things piling up into big ones.
一點好運、一次剛好的相遇或機會；不大，但值得抓住。: A bit of luck, a well-timed meeting or chance — small, but worth grabbing.
七天裡，每天睡前寫下一件你想他的事，和一件你身邊真實發生的事。第七天看一看，想念: For seven days, before bed, write down one thing about missing them and one thing that really happened around you. On day seven, see whether the missing outweighs reality.
七天裡，每天睡前寫下一件你放下的事。第七天想一想，放下是不是比硬撐輕鬆。: For seven days, before bed, write down one thing you let go of. On day seven, think about whether letting go is easier than holding on.
七天裡，每天睡前記下一件你今天在路上看到的人或事。第七天想一想，哪條路讓你最想遇: For seven days, before bed, note one person or thing you saw while out that day. On day seven, think about which road makes you most want to meet someone.
七天裡，每天睡前記下一件你出門遇到的事。第七天回頭看，出門是不是比關門有用。: For seven days, before bed, note one thing that happened when you went out. On day seven, look back: isn't going out more useful than staying in?
七天裡，每天睡前記下一件日常裡的小幸福。第七天回頭看，平淡的日子是不是也有光。: For seven days, before bed, note one small everyday happiness. On day seven, look back: don't ordinary days have their own light?
丈夫是我們要仰望、託付終身的人，如今竟是這個樣子。: A husband is the one we look up to and entrust our lives to — and now he turns out like this.
三分鐘熱度，說得多做得少。: Enthusiasm that fizzles fast — lots of talk, little action.
三天內，主動對他好一次，不用大，一件小事就夠，看他會不會也對你好一次。: Within three days, do something kind for them first — nothing big, one small thing is enough — and see whether they do something kind in return.
三天內，主動打個招呼，別等好消息自己敲門，一句話就能開頭。: Within three days, say hello first. Don't wait for good news to knock; one sentence is enough to begin.
三天內，主動找他一次，把你想說的話說了，別再等所謂的對的時機。: Within three days, reach out to them and say what you want to say. Stop waiting for the so-called right moment.
三天內，主動找他說句話，別再原地等，往前走吧。: Within three days, reach out and say something first. Stop waiting where you are — move forward.
三天內，主動約他一次，時機熟了就別再等，行動比等待有用。: Within three days, ask them out first. When the time is ripe, stop waiting — action beats waiting.
三天內，先停手，別再推進關係了，把你們之間沒解決的問題列出來，一件一件看。: Within three days, stop pushing the relationship forward. List the unresolved problems between you and look at them one by one.
三天內，先停手，別再追了，把你一直用的方法寫下來，看看錯在哪裡。: Within three days, stop chasing. Write down the approach you've been using and see where it's going wrong.
